**ADVOCATE OFFICE ADDRESS / LETTERHEAD**
[Name of the Advocate]
Advocate, High Court / District Court
[Office Address]
[Mobile Number / Email Address]

**Date:** [Insert Date]

**BY REGISTERED POST WITH ACKNOWLEDGEMENT DUE / SPEED POST**

**TO,**
[Name of the Tenant]
[Address of the Rented Premises]
Pune, Maharashtra - [Pin Code]

**SUBJECT: LEGAL NOTICE FOR PAYMENT OF ARREARS OF RENT AMOUNTING TO RS. 90,000/- AND DEMAND TO VACATE PREMISES.**

Sir/Madam,

Under instructions from and on behalf of my client, [Name of the Landlord], residing at [Landlord’s Address], Pune (hereinafter referred to as "my Client"), I hereby serve upon you this Legal Notice:

1. That my Client is the absolute owner of the residential/commercial premises situated at [Insert Full Address of the Let-Out Property], Pune (hereinafter referred to as the "Demised Premises").

2. That you were inducted as a tenant by my Client in respect of the Demised Premises under a Agreement/Lease Deed dated [Insert Date] on a monthly rent of Rs. 15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand Only), payable on or before the [Insert Day, e.g., 5th] day of each calendar month.

3. That under the terms of the tenancy, you were obligated to pay the agreed monthly rent regularly and punctually to my Client without any delay or default.

4. That you have persistently defaulted in paying the monthly rent for the past six (6) months, specifically for the period from [Insert Starting Month, e.g., November 2024] to [Insert Ending Month, e.g., April 2025], accumulating a total outstanding rent amount of **Rs. 90,000/- (Rupees Ninety Thousand Only)**.

5. That my Client personally as well as through oral requests repeatedly demanded the payment of the overdue rent, but you have failed, neglected, and refused to pay the said outstanding amount on one pretext or another, thereby committed a deliberate breach of the tenancy terms.

6. That your failure to pay rent constitutes a willful default, rendering you liable for eviction and recovery of the total accrued arrears along with interest under the applicable provisions of the Maharashtra Rent Control Act, 1999 [VERIFY].

**NOW THEREFORE, YOU ARE HEREBY CALLED UPON TO:**

> **A.** Remit the outstanding rent arrears of **Rs. 90,000/- (Rupees Ninety Thousand Only)** with interest @ [Insert Rate, e.g., 18%] p.a. to my Client within **fifteen (15) days** of receipt hereof; and
> 
> **B.** Hand over vacant and peaceful possession of the Demised Premises to my Client upon expiry of the said fifteen (15) days.

Please note that if you fail to comply with the requisitions of this notice within the stipulated period of fifteen (15) days, my Client has given me strict instructions to initiate appropriate legal proceedings against you in the competent court of law at Pune for recovery of rent, mesne profits/damages, and eviction at your sole risk, cost, and consequences.

A copy of this notice has been retained in my office for future reference and legal record.

Yours faithfully,

_______________________
**[Name of the Advocate]**
Advocate for [Name of the Landlord]
